goals.summary: Introduce a command suggestion mechanism to Typer that detects typos and suggests similar commands upon execution errors.

facets.summary: Users face unhelpful errors like 'No such command' without guidance when mistyping CLI commands.
Detects similar commands via difflib and SequenceMatcher, prompting users with 'Did you mean ...?' suggestions.

Implements CommandSuggester supporting missing/extra characters, vowel/consonant omissions, substring/case-insensitive matching, confidence-ranked suggestions, SmartTyperApp integration, and zero external dependencies.
Author reports 28 passing unit tests covering all scenarios, unaffected existing tests, and evaluation against Git, Docker, and NPM patterns.

candidates.whyInspect: Implements the core matching logic using SequenceMatcher and close matches to produce ordered typo suggestions.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Does the matching algorithm accurately identify typos and handle edge cases like short command names or casing without excessive false positives?
candidates.uncertainty: Lines 68-72 and helper formatting methods are truncated between this chunk and subsequent methods.

candidates.whyInspect: Implements SmartTyperApp, command dispatching, and error raising with suggestion messages when a command is not found.
candidates.reviewQuestion: How does SmartTyperApp integrate with standard Typer CLI execution and error reporting rather than just raising generic ValueErrors?
candidates.uncertainty: Implementation details of format_suggestion_message and format_multiple_suggestions_message are not shown in this chunk.

candidates.whyInspect: Defines CommandSuggester initialization, alias handling, and typo category classification.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Are alias mappings properly tracked and isolated to avoid duplicate suggestion candidates?
candidates.uncertainty: The default threshold and configuration options are fixed in init without CLI-level exposure shown here.

candidates.whyInspect: Shows how Typer wires suggest_commands into group creation from Typer instances.
candidates.reviewQuestion: How is suggest_commands configured on Typer instances and propagated down to Click group resolution?
candidates.uncertainty: The definition of suggest_commands on Typer and get_group_from_info implementation are located in unread sections.

candidates.whyInspect: Provides suggestions alongside calculated confidence ratios sorted descending.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Does the confidence-scoring logic stay consistent with get_suggestions when handling exact matches and thresholds?
candidates.uncertainty: Exact matching early returns present in get_suggestions appear differently structured here.

candidates.whyInspect: Tests SmartTyperApp error raising and suggestion inclusion when invoking unknown commands.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Do these tests verify integration with Click and rich console output or only standalone ValueError raising?
candidates.uncertainty: Tests only assert substring inclusion in ValueError.

candidates.whyInspect: Unit tests verifying missing character, extra character, and substring matching for CommandSuggester.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Are get_suggestion single-match return tests aligned with the list-returning implementation in suggestions.py?
candidates.uncertainty: Method get_suggestion called in tests is not visible in the provided suggestions.py chunks.

candidates.whyInspect: Validates suggestion behavior against CLI command sets modeled after Git, Docker, and NPM.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Do typical real-world command sets yield acceptable suggestion accuracy under standard thresholds?
candidates.uncertainty: Tests check basic single-typo assertions without checking edge cases or command collision.
